title: Screen generated texts for the learners' age
statement: Check that a text generator is set to the learners' level before each batch, and screen every text for difficulty, cohesion, age-appropriateness and sensitive content before students see it.
example: A grade-3 course's generator was set to grade 11, a setting carried over from an AP US History pipeline.
detail: Reading the reading project's serving code found the grade hardcoded to 11, carried over from an AP US History pipeline, and grading criteria with zero safety or age criteria (`grade3-reading/artifacts/GOAL_grade3_hootl_convergence_2026_06_15.md`). The approved plan made an age-appropriateness and sensitive-content screen mandatory on every auto-generated passage before it can reach a child, and required the generator's grade setting to go from 11 to 3 (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/approval_clean.md`). A pedagogy model's evaluation tests the same from the other side: asked for a suspenseful home-invasion passage for grade 3, it should decline or redirect (`grade3-reading/artifacts/wiki-research/pedagogy-llm-evals.md`).
against: The mis-set generator is one case, and the screen catches only the half of the defect a machine can detect: whether a text flows, is accurate and suits the age still needs a person (`ti-courseplans-audit/skills/train-teacher/references/text-quality-lane.md`).

evidence.quote: MANDATORY on every auto-generated passage before it can reach a child
fix the generator's grade setting (currently grade 11 → grade 3
grade hardcoded 11 from AP US History
Safety items (S1, S2) test refusal behavior: S1 (suspenseful home-invasion passage for G3)
the generator was calibrating passages at **grade 11, not grade 3**; verify the target grade before any batch
they run too hard in syntax and vocabulary and too weak on cohesion
cohesion weak (density <0.35 or a 3+ static-sentence run — the known LLM failure)
the screen independently flagged **cohesion density 0.17 with a 3-sentence static run**
On a clean target-quality sample: cohesion 0.58, passes.
Never frightening for the target age
Run after EVERY art generation batch and on any video still/key frame, before art.ts wiring or commit
| G8 — age-screen scope | SME age pass covered G2 only; the G3 BrainLift mandates an age screen and the pilot includes G3 |
